plaatsen.tekst: Wherefore Adonizedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,
Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
